$schemaNote: Draft content for There and Back — Journey catalog, second catalog entry (CLAUDE.md §14, this quest added 2026-09-05). See §4/§6.2 for target schema and `assets/journeys/odyssey-ithaca/locations.json` for the field-by-field precedent this file follows. `narrative` is the in-fiction traveler's line (what the app shows); this quest has no real-world setting, so it carries no `historicalNote` field at all (contrast odyssey-ithaca, where about half the landmarks do) — there is nothing to anchor one to. Each segment carries `departureHour` (0-24, the in-fiction local hour at `fromMeters`) and `durationDays` (in-fiction days elapsed crossing to `toMeters`) — CLAUDE.md §6.1's fictional sky reads these, via `fictionalHourFor`, to show the story's own time of day at the route position the 'Путь' scene is scrolled to. `durationDays` is capped by a pace-safety rule (`journey_timing_repository.dart`): at most 1 in-fiction day per 10 000 real meters of the segment — every segment below already sits at or under that cap without needing any compression (contrast odyssey-ithaca's mythic, multi-year stays), so no `timeNote` is needed to explain a shortened duration; the `timeNote` a few segments do carry only glosses the story reason a stretch feels longer or shorter than its real distance.

journey.name: The Road to the Skyfire
journey.source: Original fantasy content, no external IP

segments.name: The Open Door
segments.timeNote: The first stretch feels slow and overwhelming to her, but the journey's story-time is compressed to two days.

segments.name: The Singing Pines
segments.timeNote: The forest crossing represents several days of wandering, compressed into three journey-days.

segments.name: The Golden Fields
segments.timeNote: The long road through the farming country is condensed into three days.

segments.name: The River of Mills
segments.timeNote: The river settlements are crossed quickly despite the many small villages along the water.

segments.name: The Sunken Road
segments.timeNote: The marsh seems endless, but the playable journey compresses the crossing to three days.

segments.name: The Blue Mountains
segments.timeNote: The mountain ascent would take much longer for ordinary travelers, but the story compresses it to three days.

segments.name: The Salt Coast
segments.timeNote: The coast road is long but unusually direct, allowing the journey to remain within three days.

segments.name: The Lantern Fields
segments.timeNote: The final approach is timed around the annual release of skyfire.

landmarks.name: The Bellglass Window
landmarks.narrative: For the first time, I can see the whole valley without bars between us.

landmarks.name: The Empty Stair
landmarks.narrative: My footsteps sound strange on the stairs because no one is waiting below.

landmarks.name: The Thorn Gate
landmarks.narrative: The old iron gate is tangled in thorns, yet it opens with barely a touch.

landmarks.name: The First Road
landmarks.narrative: I keep looking back at the tower as though it might call my name.

landmarks.name: The Stone Marker
landmarks.narrative: A weathered stone points toward places I have only ever read about.

landmarks.name: The Pine Arch
landmarks.narrative: The forest closes around me, and every tree seems taller than the tower.

landmarks.name: The Mossy Bell
landmarks.narrative: A little bronze bell hangs from a branch, ringing whenever the wind turns.

landmarks.name: Foxglove Hollow
landmarks.narrative: Purple flowers cover the hollow like tiny cups waiting for rain.

landmarks.name: The Whispering Bridge
landmarks.narrative: The wooden bridge creaks beneath me, but the river below is perfectly calm.

landmarks.name: The Old Campfire
landmarks.narrative: Someone once slept here beneath the pines, and I wonder what they dreamed about.

landmarks.name: The Sunlit Clearing
landmarks.narrative: I step into the clearing and realize I have stopped being afraid of the open sky.

landmarks.name: The Last Pine
landmarks.narrative: Beyond the last pine, the world suddenly becomes impossibly wide.

landmarks.name: The Golden Grass
landmarks.narrative: The grass reaches my knees and brushes against me like warm water.

landmarks.name: Windmill Hill
landmarks.narrative: Seven windmills turn slowly on the hill, all facing the same distant horizon.

landmarks.name: The Red-Roof Farm
landmarks.narrative: The smell of fresh bread reaches me long before I see the farmhouse.

landmarks.name: The Blue Corn
landmarks.narrative: Blue-tipped grain ripples across the field, shining whenever the wind bends it.

landmarks.name: The Lonely Oak
landmarks.narrative: I rest beneath the oak and find a whole world of insects moving through its roots.

landmarks.name: The Ribbon Road
landmarks.narrative: The road winds through the fields like a ribbon someone dropped from the sky.

landmarks.name: The Crow Fence
landmarks.narrative: Black birds line the fence posts and watch me pass without making a sound.

landmarks.name: The First River View
landmarks.narrative: At the edge of the fields, I finally see the silver river cutting through the valley.

landmarks.name: The Millwheel
landmarks.narrative: A huge wooden wheel turns in the current with a rhythm I could almost dance to.

landmarks.name: The Stone Ford
landmarks.narrative: I cross the river on flat stones while minnows flash between my feet.

landmarks.name: The Riverside Market
landmarks.narrative: Voices, bells, spices, and bright cloth crowd together in the riverside market.

landmarks.name: The Three Bridges
landmarks.narrative: Three bridges cross the river here, and for once I am glad there are too many choices.

landmarks.name: The Heron Bank
landmarks.narrative: A grey heron stands perfectly still beside the water as if it has been waiting for me.

landmarks.name: The Old Watergate
landmarks.narrative: The old watergate groans in the current, its stones covered in pale river moss.

landmarks.name: The Marsh Road
landmarks.narrative: The firm road disappears into wet ground, and the air suddenly smells of reeds.

landmarks.name: The Reed Gate
landmarks.narrative: Tall reeds hide the path until I notice a row of white stones beneath them.

landmarks.name: The Sunken Statue
landmarks.narrative: A stone face rises from the water with moss covering its forgotten smile.

landmarks.name: The Blackwater Pool
landmarks.narrative: The pool is dark enough to reflect the clouds even when the sun is bright.

landmarks.name: The Broken Causeway
landmarks.narrative: Only a few stones remain above the water, forcing me to choose each step carefully.

landmarks.name: The Drowned Garden
landmarks.narrative: Half-submerged statues and flowering vines reveal that this marsh was once someone's garden.

landmarks.name: The Dry Ground
landmarks.narrative: The mud finally gives way to dry stone, and I realize I have been holding my breath.

landmarks.name: The Mountain Gate
landmarks.narrative: Two dark peaks frame the road ahead like the entrance to another country.

landmarks.name: The Blue Stone Path
landmarks.narrative: Blue-grey stones mark the mountain path, each one polished smooth by countless travelers.

landmarks.name: The Cloud Shelf
landmarks.narrative: I climb high enough for the clouds to drift beneath the trail.

landmarks.name: The Goat Bells
landmarks.narrative: Tiny bells echo somewhere above me, though I cannot see what carries them.

landmarks.name: The Echo Cave
landmarks.narrative: Inside the cave, even my smallest breath returns to me from the dark.

landmarks.name: The High Meadow
landmarks.narrative: Small white flowers grow between the rocks where I expected to find nothing.

landmarks.name: The Wind-Carved Arch
landmarks.narrative: The wind has carved a perfect arch through the stone, framing a strip of distant sea.

landmarks.name: The Last Ascent
landmarks.narrative: I take the final steep steps and feel the mountains falling away behind me.

landmarks.name: The Sea Horizon
landmarks.narrative: The sea stretches farther than I ever imagined the world could stretch.

landmarks.name: The Salt Road
landmarks.narrative: White salt dust covers the road and sparkles beneath my boots.

landmarks.name: The Driftwood Camp
landmarks.narrative: Someone has built a tiny shelter from driftwood where the cliffs meet the beach.

landmarks.name: The Sea Caves
landmarks.narrative: Waves rush into the caves below me and return carrying clouds of silver foam.

landmarks.name: The White Lighthouse
landmarks.narrative: A lonely white lighthouse turns its beam across the evening sea.

landmarks.name: The Shell Stairs
landmarks.narrative: Shells have been pressed into the old cliff stairs until every step shines.

landmarks.name: The Tide Pool
landmarks.narrative: Tiny creatures move through the tide pool, completely unaware of how large the world is.

landmarks.name: Lantern Hill
landmarks.narrative: Beyond the final rise, I see warm lights scattered across a distant meadow.

landmarks.name: The Field Gate
landmarks.narrative: A simple wooden gate stands open, covered in hundreds of little painted stars.

landmarks.name: The Gathering Meadow
landmarks.narrative: People are gathering quietly in the meadow, carrying covered glass vessels.

landmarks.name: The Glassfire Tables
landmarks.narrative: Inside the glass vessels, tiny golden lights pulse like distant stars.

landmarks.name: The Circle of Stones
landmarks.narrative: I enter a circle of standing stones where everyone has fallen silent.

landmarks.name: The First Skyfire
landmarks.narrative: One golden light rises above the meadow, and I forget to breathe.

landmarks.name: The River of Lights
landmarks.narrative: Hundreds of glowing motes climb into the darkness until the sky looks like a second river.

landmarks.name: Under the Skyfire
landmarks.narrative: I stand beneath the lights and finally understand that the world was never as small as my tower.
